the translation of mRNA from brain tissue in Xenopus oocyte leads to appearance of sodium and calcium currents in oocyte membrane.

the development of the method of isolation and translation of brain mRNA in Xenopus oocyte.
the study of the mechanisms of action of the brain mRNA.
the study of the mechanisms of the translation of the mRNA in the oocyte of Xenopus laevis.

the mRNA injection into oocyte membrane induces the expression of functional ion channels and receptors.
